name: react-native-nativescope
description: A local, plug-and-play debugging environment for React Native apps.
author: Caio Barroso

scripts.build: npm run build:ui && npm run build:cli && npm run build:runtime-bundle
scripts.build:cli:
esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __rnsiCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __rnsiCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && chmod +x dist/cli.mjs
scripts.build:runtime-bundle: esbuild ../../packages/runtime/src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --platform=neutral --main-fields=module,main --outfile=metro/shims/runtime-bundle.js --banner:js="/* generated - bundled @rnsi/runtime for NativeScope shims (__RNSI_SHIM__) */"
